Payload:
```yaml
status: DONE
round: 1
batch_id: expert-method-review-batch-1
review_snapshot_id: expert-method-source-and-pilot-snapshot-1
snapshot_identity:
  basis: content_digest
  value: sha256:fa0979e10c8e6e9ae6832b0fd49c0e6be39cc229ae96ef2ba94874b2cd382c3e
  captured_at: "2026-10-22T18:26:57.512055+00:00"
  scope_manifest_digest: sha256:cbf156285cf168b146658ab4a07f7fb127897a770f30a73e04c934a9e02b5ed1
review_pass_id: P-evidence
review_attempt_id: expert-method-review-attempt-1
review_perspective: integration_compatibility_and_consumers
pass_completion_state: completed

reviewed_scope:
  - docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/results.md and results.json
  - docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/plan.md, selection.json, conditions.md, conditions-addendum.md, prompts.json, rubric.md, source-manifest.json, nochange-decision.json and report-freeze.json
  - All four subject implementations, supporting inputs, case oracles and retained smoke controls
  - All eight retained events.jsonl, final.txt, prompt.txt, start.json, exit.json and stderr.redacted.txt captures
  - docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/evidence/capture-manifest.json, runtime-final.json and development/preflight-summary.json
  - skills/assistant-skill-creator/SKILL.md and references/expert-method-design.md, limited to downstream integration and observation-claim boundaries

findings: []

coverage_entries:
  - scope_item_id: scope-pilot-evidence
    applicable_concern: concern-evaluation-evidence
    review_perspective: integration_compatibility_and_consumers
    coverage_obligation: validate-pilot-oracles-traces-claims-and-resource-bound
    status: inspected_no_risk
    evidence: >-
      Inspected all four implementations/oracles, all eight final responses and all
      82 completed command events, including inline Python. Runnable cases contain
      discriminating interventions and adverse controls; historical-evidence cases
      actually observe exit 3 and abstain from exact causality. Independently
      reconciled command counts, referenced event lines/item IDs, final messages,
      native usage, starts/exits, preserved-file hashes and paired prompts.
      All 117 report-freeze file hashes and all frozen fixture/oracle hashes match.
      Eight recorded starts precede terminal exit 0; held-out starts follow the
      recorded no-change freeze. Reports retain the resource and isolation limits.
  - scope_item_id: scope-creator-human
    applicable_concern: concern-downstream-integration
    review_perspective: integration_compatibility_and_consumers
    coverage_obligation: validate-authoring-change-and-observation-claim-boundaries
    status: inspected_no_risk
    evidence: >-
      SKILL.md:70-76 conditionally routes expert-judgment authoring.
      expert-method-design.md:11-38 reuses existing success criteria and canonical
      verification outputs; lines 40-46 and 58-63 explicitly withhold measured
      creator-benefit claims. results.md:11-14 and 122-125 separately disclose that
      no creator-task comparison occurred. The debugging tie is not presented as
      evidence of creator improvement or used to justify a debugging source change.

summary: >-
  No material findings within the reviewed scope and available evidence.
  The retained executions support the reported four-case diagnosis/authority tie,
  including appropriate inconclusive outcomes. The report preserves the useful
  extra concurrency observation without promoting it to a stable advantage.
  Creator guidance remains an authoring hypothesis assessed separately from this
  debugging comparison. This is the P-evidence verdict only.

evidence:
  - source: /Users/laimis/.codex/skills/assistant-review/contracts/handoffs.yaml
    detail: >-
      Resolved fresh_reviewer_context.worker_return_schema_selector to
      handoffs.orchestrator_to_reviewer.return_fields and loaded its recursive
      required/conditional field shapes; this return follows that schema.
  - source: docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/rubric.md and four case oracles
    detail: >-
      Accept equivalent causal explanations and actual discriminating observations;
      reject exception-label diagnosis, dependency-slowdown assumptions,
      distinct-key false duplicates and invented historical causes.
  - source: docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/evidence/development/trial-01/events.jsonl:20
    detail: >-
      Genuine database-delay control reaches one query, while lines 21-22 show
      admission failure with zero queries even at zero database delay.
      Trial-02 independently provides the same distinction.
  - source: docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/evidence/heldout/trial-03/events.jsonl:16
    detail: >-
      Current profile fails at 30 ms versus 0.08 ms; line 18 shows previous profile
      succeeding at the same delay. Both arms probe the threshold and qualify the
      missing producer/loader implementation.
  - source: docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/evidence/heldout/trial-06/events.jsonl:33
    detail: >-
      Inspected the entire in-memory delayed-response probe and its output.
      It demonstrates two accepted same-key payments without the lookup barrier,
      then demonstrates cached replies after publication. No source write occurs.
      Both concurrency arms also execute serial/same and distinct-key controls.
  - source: docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/evidence/heldout/trial-07/events.jsonl:18
    detail: >-
      Historical capture actually exits 3 as unavailable; line 20 returns a later
      saved health response. Trial-08 independently observes the same distinction,
      and both final answers leave the exact cause unresolved.
  - source: docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/evidence/capture-manifest.json
    detail: >-
      Reconciliation found no mismatches among completed-command counts,
      inventory references, result references, native usage, start/exit records,
      final agent messages and all 48 preserved capture-file hashes.
      All four current traces contain the exact frozen target body; disabled
      traces do not. All paired prompts and common CLI arguments match.
  - source: docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/report-freeze.json and source-manifest.json
    detail: >-
      Independently verified all 117 declared file hashes, report-list digest,
      frozen artifacts, four subject file sets/tree digests and oracle hashes.
      This verifies retained bytes, not historical pre-start hashing or all host state.
  - source: docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/results.md:94
    detail: >-
      Clearly records the independent per-run pre-start hash gap, broader read
      access, unlocalized sandbox warnings and limits of command auditing.
      Warning counts reconcile to trials 02, 06 and 07.
  - source: docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/results.md:113
    detail: >-
      Redaction disclosures match one private-endpoint replacement per stderr.
      Retained evidence contains no HTTP(S) URL strings; raw configuration and
      full preflight context are excluded. Original stderr redaction correctness
      is supported by recorded hashes/disclosure, not independently reconstructed here.
  - source: docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/results.md:68
    detail: >-
      Resource figures match native turn-completed usage and exit elapsed records.
      No overlapping categories are summed, monetary cost is unavailable, and
      concurrent host/load/cache confounding is explicit.
  - source: docs/plans/expert-method-pilot/selection.json
    detail: >-
      Preserved the selected boundary: existing checks, zero new executable-test
      assertions, TDD false/not_selected and a 12-start hard cap. This pass used
      read-only artifact inspection and reconciliation; no model evaluations,
      fixture executions, edits or additional tests were performed.

semantic_contract_checks:
  inherited_contract_obligations: >-
    Within this pass, diagnosis-only authority and calibrated evidence are retained.
    Creator detail reuses existing success criteria and verification carriers.
    No claim of full debugging output-schema conformance is inferred from the pilot.
  template_contract_alignment: >-
    No competing report/schema is introduced by the inspected creator reference.
    Detailed selector/gate validation belongs to the separate assigned contract pass.
  eval_inheritance_coverage: >-
    The pilot checks conclusions, actual evidence, authority and observed work
    separately; frozen controls reject plausible wrong outcomes and accept
    supported inconclusive results.
  external_method_signature_fidelity: >-
    No measured benefit is attributed to the cited authoring methods.
    External-source fidelity itself is outside this integration pass.
  high_stakes_recommendation_guard: >-
    Synthetic payment and incident tasks remain local diagnosis-only observations;
    no real payment, remote access or applied repair is authorized or observed.
  mirror_surface_sync: >-
    No runtime result is used to claim native activation or generated-surface
    correctness. Guide parity is assigned to the separate contract pass.

principle_checks:
  solid: No concrete risk found within the inspected integration boundary.
  kiss: >-
    No concrete risk found; the no-change disposition avoids an unsupported
    debugging addition and redundant identical third-arm observations.
  dry: >-
    No concrete risk found; creator detail reuses canonical success criteria
    and verification outputs.
  yagni: >-
    No concrete risk found; no universal expert mode, new schema, quota or
    dependency is introduced by the inspected authoring detail.
  readability: >-
    No concrete risk found; results separate conclusions, commands, authority,
    resources and preservation limits.
  design_coherence: >-
    No concrete risk found. Creator guidance owns authoring decisions; the pilot
    owns bounded debugging observations. Neither claims the other's validation.

reuse_search:
  applicability: applicable
  applicability_reason: >-
    Checked whether authoring and evaluation claim rules reuse existing
    verification semantics rather than establish competing authority.
  searches:
    - query_or_path: skills/assistant-verification/references/methods/behavioral-evals.md
      scope: Existing behavioral-evaluation guidance
      outcome: >-
        Already distinguishes forced loading/native routing, actual observations,
        adverse outcomes, frozen comparisons, ties and resource limits.
    - query_or_path: skills/assistant-skill-creator/SKILL.md:84-104
      scope: Existing creator validation and evidence consumers
      outcome: >-
        Canonical selection/evidence, TDD choice and runtime claim boundaries
        remain the consumed interfaces.
  candidates:
    - name: Canonical behavioral-evaluation guidance
      location: skills/assistant-verification/references/methods/behavioral-evals.md
      disposition: reuse
      rationale: The pilot follows these existing claim and observation distinctions.
    - name: Creator canonical verification carriers
      location: skills/assistant-skill-creator/SKILL.md:91-104
      disposition: reuse
      rationale: The new reference directs existing consumers to unchanged carriers.
  decision: reuse
  decision_rationale: >-
    No conflicting authoritative evaluation rule or additional universal output
    requirement was found within the assigned scope.

rubric_scores:
  correctness: 5.0
  code_quality: 5.0
  architecture: 5.0
  security: 5.0
  test_coverage: 4.0
  weighted_score: 4.85
  action: PASS
  score_justification:
    correctness: >-
      results.md:3-14 and 42-66 agree with inspected commands and final answers;
      claims remain bounded to the observed cases.
    code_quality: >-
      results.md separates outcome, evidence, resource observations and limits;
      exact event references resolve.
    architecture: >-
      expert-method-design.md:32-38 retains canonical verification ownership;
      creator and debugging evidence boundaries remain separate.
    security: >-
      Captured commands stay local and diagnosis-only; stderr endpoints are
      redacted with disclosure. Broader host effects remain explicitly unknown.
    test_coverage: >-
      Selected artifact/behavior evidence is discriminating and current.
      Independent per-run pre-start hashes and complete host/backend/inventory
      equality remain explicit limitations, without stronger claims.

verdict: clean
```
